description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hikkaduwa, Hikkaduwa D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810105
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and encumbrances) in the Hikkaduwa area. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
